author: illusion6383
quote: Genuinely a waste of money, terrible boring slow story, ridden with bugs, choppy and not even stable at 30fps. It doesn't even feel like GTA, it's like a weird modded GTA 5 but stripped of all the humour and fun gameplay and replaced with horrendously bad characters, awful writing and tedious work. Plus making you pay for features that should have been included by default. Shame on you rockstar. Also anyone saying all these negative reviews are just view bombs they are wrong. All the critics and journalists got paid off or were threatened by rockstar with a blacklist if they didn't give it a 10/10, and many people have come forward claiming that's true.
